title: Reset
summary: Four minutes to step out of a hard moment and come back steadier.

segments.text: This is a short reset for the middle of a day that's asking a lot of you.
Wherever you are, let your feet rest on the floor, and let your shoulders drop away from your ears.
Take a breath in through your nose. Then a second, smaller sip of air on top of it. And let it all go slowly through your mouth.
Once more. In through the nose, a little more on top, and a long, slow breath out.
Now let your breathing return to its own pace.
Notice what's here right now. Maybe tension somewhere. Maybe a racing thought. You don't need to fix it. Just name it, quietly, to yourself.
Look for three things you can hear. Near or far. Loud or faint.
Now feel two places where your body is supported. The chair. The floor. Your own hands resting.
And notice one breath, all the way in, and all the way out.
Whatever was happening before this is still there. But you're meeting it from a slightly steadier place.
Before you go back to your day, take one more slow breath out.
That's your reset. You can come back to it whenever you need.
